title: Little Rein Club: toddler, pre-school and reception pony sessions near Bath
description: Gentle early years pony and craft sessions near Bath for toddlers, pre-school and reception children, combining nature, play, creativity and early learning.

sections.heading: Little Rein Club
sections.lede: We want your child to feel safe and confident around horses: comfortable touching them, interacting with them, or simply being in their presence.

image.alt: A toddler in a bobble hat standing at a stable door while a black pony leans down to sniff their hat

sections.heading: Gentle early years sessions
sections.body:
At Creative Rein we offer gentle early years equine and craft programmes for little ones, combining nature, play, creativity and early learning.

We bring together pony experiences, outdoor adventures, indoor crafts when it's cold, creative activities and opportunities to learn through play.

With the Little Rein Club, children will meet our friendly ponies, learn about pony care, enjoy gentle grooming, explore different textures and begin to understand how to treat animals with kindness.

image.alt: Poppet, a dark bay horse with a white star, resting her head over the stable door

moreImages.alt: A blue grooming box full of soft brushes on a straw bale
A jar of paintbrushes and a watercolour palette on a straw bale

items.title: Communication & Language
items.text: Storytelling, listening, talking and expressing ideas.

items.title: Early Literacy
items.text: Looking at books, using sounds, mark making and early writing experiences.

items.title: Early Maths
items.text: Counting, sorting, matching, measuring and using shapes and patterns.

items.title: Physical Development
items.text: Movement, balance, coordination, fine motor skills and outdoor play.

items.title: Understanding the World
items.text: Learning with animals and looking at nature, seasons, habitats and the environment.

items.title: Personal, Social & Emotional Development
items.text: Building confidence, independence, friendships, sharing and understanding feelings.

items.title: Creative Expression
items.text: Enjoying music and art, using imagination and design, and exploring different materials.
